findings.issue: The datum is typed `RootDatum (Fin 48) (Fin 4 → ℤ) (Fin 4 → ℤ)`, hardcoding the numbers instead of the in-repo index type. `TauCeti.DynkinType.numRoots` was landed and `@[expose]`d specifically for this datum (its own docstring: "meant to appear in the root-index type `Fin t.numRoots` of the future pinned simply connected root datum"), and the roadmap target signature is `RootDatum (Fin t.numRoots) (Fin t.rank → ℤ) (Fin t.rank → ℤ)`. Nothing in the PR ties this branch's `48` to `F4.numRoots` — the file does not even import `NumberOfRoots` — so the type-indexed assembly has to lean on unstated defeq rather than a stated interface.
